{{Top|leg}}
'''MB1711-V''' was the designation of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] that claimed to have [[Mission 46/N|found]] the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] in the remains of [[the Graveyard]], along with information that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] was alive and located within the ruins.

==Behind the scenes==
Since the information was planted in [[Mining Outpost 11]]'s computers as part of a trap to ensnare the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], it is unclear whether or not MB1711-V is a real survey team or merely invented for the deception.
